name: How do I finance a distressed property purchase?

mainEntity.name: How do I finance a distressed property purchase?

acceptedAnswer.text: Financing a distressed property purchase typically involves traditional mortgage options, but cash offers are often more attractive to sellers and lenders due to faster closing times and reduced risk. If seeking a loan, ensure your lender is aware of the property's 'as-is' condition, as some conventional loans may have appraisal or condition requirements that distressed properties might not meet. Preparing your financing in advance is crucial to act quickly when an opportunity arises.
acceptedAnswer.description: Financing involves traditional mortgages or cash offers; cash is often preferred. Ensure your lender understands the 'as-is' condition, as this can affect loan approval.
